card.band: 4h. The scope has to be widened to several container paths to avoid one-lever. A weaker model breaks copy-on-write semantics.
card.cheat: Aliasing instead of copying is closed by mutation-after-assign checks in the dump.
card.grading: A headless GDScript benchmark with hidden typed container workloads plus a semantic result dump gate. Reward is the wall-clock median speedup against the reference.
card.reference: The PR claims about 2x on Dictionary::assign; the broader S is measured on our harness. The PR is small, so the reference size is unverified and likely under 150 lines (a K10 risk).
card.task: /app ships a Godot snapshot before the Dictionary::assign change. The agent removes needless copies across Dictionary/Array/typed container assign, convert and duplicate paths used by GDScript and the core, preserving semantics.
card.title: Godot Variant container assign and copy-avoidance speedup
